original: yogo nāma yojanā vyastānāṃ padānāmekīkaraṇam | udāharaṇaṃ tāvadyathā- pratijñā hetūdāharaṇopanayanigamanāni; tatra pratijñā- mātṛjaścāyaṃ garbhaḥ, hetuḥ- mātaramantareṇa garbhānupapatteḥ, dṛṣṭāntaḥ- kūṭāgāraḥ, upanayaḥ- yathā nānādravyasamudāyāt kūṭāgārastathā garbhanirvartanaṃ, tasmānmātṛjaścāyamityeṣāṃ pratijñāyogaḥ;
analyzed: yogaḥ nāma yojanā vyastānām padānām ekīkaraṇam udāharaṇam tāvat yathā pratijñā hetu udāharaṇa upanaya nigamanāni tatra pratijñā mātṛ jaḥ ca ayam garbhaḥ hetuḥ mātaram antareṇa garbha anupapatteḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ kūṭāgāraḥ upanayaḥ yathā nānā dravya samudāyāt kūṭāgāraḥ tathā garbha nirvartanam tasmāt mātṛ jaḥ ca ayam iti eṣām pratijñāyogaḥ

original: evamanye'pi yogārthā vyākhyeyāḥ|
analyzed: evam anye api yoga arthāḥ vyākhyeyāḥ

original: hetvartho nāmayadanyatrābhihitamanyatropapadyate; yathā- ‘samānaguṇābhyāso hi dhātūnāṃ vṛddhikāraṇam' iti vātamadhikṛtyoktaṃ, tatra vātasyeti vaktavye yadayaṃ samānaśabdaṃ dhātūnāmiti karoti, tena yathā vāyostathā rasādīnāmapi samānaguṇābhyāso vṛddhikāraṇamiti gamyate |
analyzed: hetvarthaḥ nāma yat anyatra abhihitam anyatra upapadyate yathā samāna guṇa abhyāsaḥ hi dhātūnām vṛddhi kāraṇam iti vātam adhikṛtya uktam tatra vātasya iti vaktavye yat ayam samāna śabdam dhātūnām iti karoti tena yathā vāyoḥ tathā rasa ādīnām api samāna guṇa abhyāsaḥ vṛddhi kāraṇam iti gamyate

original: padārtho nāma padasya padayoḥ padānāṃ vā'rthaḥ padārthaḥ| tatra dravyamitipadena khādayaścetanāṣaṣṭhā ucyante; padayorartho nāma yathā- ‘āyuṣo veda'iti padayorāyurbodhakaṃ tantramityarthaḥ; evaṃ padānāmapyartha udāhāryaḥ|
analyzed: padārthaḥ nāma padasya padayoḥ padānām vā arthaḥ padārthaḥ tatra dravyam iti padena kha ādayaḥ cetanā ṣaṣṭhāḥ ucyante padayoḥ arthaḥ nāma yathā āyuṣaḥ veda eti padayoḥ āyuḥ bodhakam tantram iti arthaḥ evam padānām api arthaḥ udāhāryaḥ

original: pradeśo nāma yadbahutvādarthasya kārtsnyenābhidhātumaśakyamekadeśenābhidhīyate; yathā- ‘anupānaikadeśo'yamuktaḥ prāyopayogikaḥ' ityādi|
analyzed: pradeśaḥ nāma yat bahu tvāt arthasya kārtsnyena abhidhātum aśakyam eka deśena abhidhīyate yathā anupāna eka deśaḥ yam uktaḥ prāyopayogikaḥ ityādi

original: uddeśo nāma saṅkṣepābhidhānaṃ; yathā- ‘hetuliṅgauṣadhajñānaṃ', anena sarvāyurvedābhidheyoddeśaḥ|
analyzed: uddeśaḥ nāma saṅkṣepa abhidhānam yathā hetu liṅga auṣadha jñānam anena sarva āyurveda abhidheya uddeśaḥ

original: nirdeśo nāma saṅkhyeyoktasya vivaraṇaṃ; yathā- hetuliṅgauṣadhasya punaḥ prapañcanaṃ ‘sarvadā sarvabhāvānāṃ'ityādinā ‘ityuktaṃ kāraṇaṃ' ityantena kāraṇaprapañcanamityādi|
analyzed: nirdeśaḥ nāma saṅkhyeya uktasya vivaraṇam yathā hetu liṅga auṣadhasya punar prapañcanam sarvadā sarva bhāvānām ityādinā iti uktam kāraṇam ityantena kāraṇa prapañcanam ityādi

original: vākyaśeṣo nāma yallāghavārthamācāryeṇa vākyeṣu padamakṛtaṃ gamyamānatayā pūryate; yathā ‘pravṛttirhetubhāvānāṃ' ityatra ‘asti'iti padaṃ pūryate, tathā ‘jāṅgalajai rasaiḥ'ityatra māṃsaśabdaḥ pūryate| vākyeṣu caita eva padāḥ śeṣāḥ kriyante, ye'niveśitā api pratīyante|
analyzed: vākyaśeṣaḥ nāma yat lāghava artham ācāryeṇa vākyeṣu padam akṛtam gamyamāna tayā pūryate yathā pravṛttiḥ hetu bhāvānām iti atra asti iti padam pūryate tathā jāṅgala jaiḥ rasaiḥ iti atra māṃsa śabdaḥ pūryate vākyeṣu ca ete eva padāḥ śeṣāḥ kriyante api pratīyante

original: prayojanaṃ nāma yadarthaṃ kāmayamānaḥ pravartate; yathā- ‘dhātusāmyakriyā coktā tantrasyāsya prayojanam'|
analyzed: prayojanam nāma yad artham kāmayamānaḥ pravartate yathā dhātu sāmya kriyā ca uktā tantrasya asya prayojanam

original: upadeśo nāmāptānuśāsanaṃ; yathā- ‘snehamagre prayuñjīta tataḥ svedamanantaram' ityādi |
analyzed: upadeśaḥ nāma āpta anuśāsanam yathā sneham agre prayuñjīta tatas svedam anantaram ityādi

original: apadeśo nāma yatpratijñātārthasādhanāya hetuvacanaṃ; yathā- ‘vātājjalaṃ jalāddeśaṃ deśāt kālaṃ svabhāvataḥ| vidyādduṣparihāryatvāt' ityādi, tatra pratijñātārthasya hetuvacanaṃ- duṣparihāryatvāditi |
analyzed: apadeśaḥ nāma yat pratijñāta artha sādhanāya hetu vacanam yathā vātāt jalam jalāt deśam deśāt kālam svabhāvataḥ vidyāt duṣparihārya tvāt ityādi tatra pratijñāta arthasya hetu vacanam duṣparihārya tvāt iti

original: atideśo nāma yatkiñcideva prakāśyārthamanuktārthasādhanāyaiva evamanyadapi pratyetavyamiti paribhāṣyate; yathā- ‘yaccānyadapi kiñcit syādanuktamiha pūjitam| vṛtaṃ tadapi cātreyaḥ sadaivābhyanumanyate' iti |
analyzed: atideśaḥ nāma yat kiñcid eva prakāśya artham anukta artha sādhanāya eva evam anyat api pratyetavyam iti paribhāṣyate yathā yat ca anyat api kiñcid syāt anuktam iha pūjitam vṛtam tat api ca ātreyaḥ sadā eva abhyanumanyate iti

original: arthāpattirnāma yadakirtitamarthādāpadyate sā'rthāpattiḥ; yathā- naktaṃ dadhibhojananiṣedhaḥ, arthāddivā bhuñjītetyāpadyate |
analyzed: arthāpattiḥ nāma yat a kirtitam arthāt āpadyate sā arthāpattiḥ yathā naktam dadhi bhojana niṣedhaḥ arthāt divā bhuñjīta iti āpadyate

original: nirṇayo nāma vicāritasyārthasya vyavasthāpanaṃ; yathā- catuṣpadabheṣajatvādi vicāraṃ kṛtvā'bhidhīyate-‘yaduktaṃ ṣoḍaśakalaṃ pūrvādhyāye bheṣajaṃtadyukti yuktamalamārogyāya' iti|
analyzed: nirṇayaḥ nāma vicāritasya arthasya vyavasthāpanam yathā catuṣpada bheṣaja tva ādi vicāram kṛtvā abhidhīyate yat uktam ṣoḍaśakalam pūrva adhyāye bheṣajam tat yukti yukta malam ārogyāya iti

original: prasaṅgo nāma pūrvābhihitasyārthasya prakaraṇāgatatvādinā punarabhidhānaṃ; yathā- ‘tatrātiprabhāvatāṃ dṛśyānātimātradarśanamatiyogaḥ' evamādyabhidhāya, punaḥ ‘atyugraśabdaśravaṇācchravaṇāt sarvaśo na ca' ityādinā pūrvokta evārtho'bhidhīyate|
analyzed: prasaṅgaḥ nāma pūrva abhihitasya arthasya prakaraṇa āgata tva ādinā punar abhidhānam yathā tatra atiprabhāvatām dṛśya an atimātra darśanam atiyogaḥ evamādi abhidhāya punar ati ugra śabda śravaṇāt śravaṇāt sarvaśas na ca ityādinā pūrva uktaḥ eva arthaḥ abhidhīyate

original: ekānto nāma yadavadhāraṇenocyate; yathā- nijaḥ śarīradoṣotthaḥ, trivṛdvirecayatītyādi| anaikānto nāma anyatarapakṣānavadhāraṇaṃ, yathā- ‘ye hyāturāḥ kevalādbheṣajādṛte mriyante, na ca te sarva eva bheṣajopapannāḥ samuttiṣṭheran' ityādi |
analyzed: ekāntaḥ nāma yat avadhāraṇena ucyate yathā nijaḥ śarīra doṣa utthaḥ trivṛt virecayati ityādi anaikāntaḥ nāma anyatara pakṣa anavadhāraṇam yathā ye hi āturāḥ kevalāt bheṣajāt ṛte mriyante na ca te sarve eva bheṣaja upapannāḥ samuttiṣṭheran ityādi

original: apavargo nāma sākalyenoddiṣṭasyaikadeśāpakarṣaṇaṃ; yathā- ‘na paryuṣitānnamādadītānyatra māṃsaharitakaśuṣkaśākaphalabhakṣyebhyaḥ' iti| atra hi sāmānyena paryuṣitabhakṣaṇaniṣedhaṃ kṛtvā māṃsādeḥ paryuṣitasyāpi bhakṣaṇamapakṛṣya vidhīyate|
analyzed: apavargaḥ nāma sākalyena uddiṣṭasya eka deśa apakarṣaṇam yathā na paryuṣita annam ādadīta anyatra māṃsa haritaka śuṣka śāka phala bhakṣyebhyaḥ iti atra hi sāmānyena paryuṣita bhakṣaṇa niṣedham kṛtvā māṃsa ādeḥ paryuṣitasya api bhakṣaṇam apakṛṣya vidhīyate

original: viparyayo nāma apakṛṣṭāt pratīpodāharaṇaṃ; yathā- ‘nidānoktānyasya nopaśerate viparītāni copaśerate' iti|
analyzed: viparyayaḥ nāma apakṛṣṭāt pratīpa udāharaṇam yathā nidāna uktāni asya na upaśerate viparītāni ca upaśerate iti

original: pūrvapakṣo nāma pratijñātārthasandūṣakaṃ vākyaṃ; yathā- ‘matsyānna payasā'bhyavaharet'iti pratijñātasyārthasya ‘sarvāneva matsyānna payasā'bhyavaharedanyatra cilicimāt' iti|
analyzed: pūrvapakṣaḥ nāma pratijñāta artha sandūṣakam vākyam yathā matsyān na payasā abhyavahara iti iti pratijñātasya arthasya sarvān eva matsyān na payasā abhyavaharet anyatra cilicimāt iti

original: vidhānaṃ nāma sūtrakāraśca vidhāya varṇayati; yathā- ‘malāyanāni bādhyante duṣṭairmātrādhikairmalaiḥ'ityatra duṣṭiśabdena malānāṃ hīnatvamadhikatvamācāryagṛhītamācāryo varṇayati- ‘malavṛddhiṃ gurutayā lāghavānmalasaṅkṣayam| malāyanānāṃ budhyeta saṅgotsargādatīva ca' iti;
analyzed: vidhānam nāma sūtrakāraḥ ca vidhāya varṇayati yathā malāyanāni bādhyante duṣṭaiḥ mātra adhikaiḥ malaiḥ iti atra duṣṭi śabdena malānām hīna tvam adhika tvam ācārya gṛhītam ācāryaḥ varṇayati mala vṛddhim gurutayā lāghavāt mala saṅkṣayam malāyanānām budhyeta saṅga utsargāt atīva ca iti

original: kecittu prakaraṇānupūrvyā'rthābhidhānaṃ vidhānamāhuḥ, yathā- rasarudhiramāṃsamedosthimajjaśukrāṇāmutpādakramānurodhenābhidhānam| anumataṃ nāma ekīyamatasyānivāraṇenānumananaṃ; yathā- ‘garbhaśalyasya jarāyuḥprapātanaṃ karma saṃśamanamityeke' ityādyekīyamataṃ pratipādyāpratiṣedhādanumanyate|
analyzed: kecid tu prakaraṇa ānupūrvya artha abhidhānam vidhānam āhuḥ yathā rasa rudhira māṃsa medaḥ sthi majja śukrāṇām utpāda krama anurodhena abhidhānam anumatam nāma ekīya matasya anivāraṇena anumananam yathā garbha śalyasya jarāyuḥ prapātanam karma saṃśamanam iti eke ityādi ekīya matam pratipādya apratiṣedhāt anumanyate

original: vyākhyānaṃ nāma yat sarvabuddhyaviṣayaṃ vyākriyate, yathā- ‘prathame māsi sammūrchitaḥ sarvadhātukaluṣīkṛtaḥ kheṭabhūto bhavatyavyaktavigrahaḥ' ityādinā'smadādyaviditārthavyākaraṇam|
analyzed: vyākhyānam nāma yat sarva buddhi aviṣayam vyākriyate yathā prathame māsi sammūrchitaḥ sarva dhātu kaluṣīkṛtaḥ kheṭa bhūtaḥ bhavati avyakta vigrahaḥ ityādinā asmat ādi avidita artha vyākaraṇam

original: saṃśayo nāma viśeṣākāṅkṣānirdhāritobhayaviṣayajñānaṃ, yathā- ‘mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caike manyante janmakāraṇam| svabhāvaṃ paranirmāṇaṃ yadṛcchāṃ cāpare janāḥ||' ityādinoktaḥ saṃśayaḥ|
analyzed: saṃśayaḥ nāma viśeṣa ākāṅkṣā nirdhārita ubhaya viṣaya jñānam yathā mātaram pitaram ca eke manyante janma kāraṇam svabhāvam para nirmāṇam yadṛcchām ca apare janāḥ ityādinā uktaḥ saṃśayaḥ

original: atītāvekṣaṇaṃ nāma yadatītamevocyate; yathā- ‘sā kuṭī tacca śayanaṃ jvaraṃ saṃśamayatyapi' ityatra svedādhyāyavihitakuṭyādikamatītamavekṣate anāgatāvekṣaṇaṃ nāma yadanāgataṃ vidhiṃ pramāṇikṛtyārthasādhanaṃ; yathā- ‘athavā tiktasarpiṣaḥ'ityādyanāgatāvekṣaṇenocyate| svasaṃjñā nāma yā tantrakārairvyavahārārthaṃ saṃjñākriyate;
analyzed: atītāvekṣaṇam nāma yat atītam eva ucyate yathā sā kuṭī tat ca śayanam jvaram saṃśamayati api iti atra sveda adhyāya vihita kuṭī ādikam atītam avekṣate anāgatāvekṣaṇam nāma yat anāgatam vidhim pramāṇi kṛtya artha sādhanam yathā athavā tikta sarpiṣaḥ ityādi anāgatāvekṣaṇena ucyate svasaṃjñā nāma yā tantra kāraiḥ vyavahāra artham saṃjñā kriyate

original: yathā- jentākaholākādikā svasaṃjñā |
analyzed: yathā jentāka holāka ādikā sva saṃjñā

original: ūhyaṃ nāma yadanibaddhaṃ granthe prajñayā tarkyatvenopadiśyate; yathā- ‘parisaṅkhyātamapi yadyad dravyamayaugikaṃ manyeta tattadapakarṣayet' iti|
analyzed: ūhyam nāma yat anibaddham granthe prajñayā tarkya tvena upadiśyate yathā parisaṅkhyātam api yat yat dravyam ayaugikam manyeta tat tat apakarṣayet iti

original: samuccayo nāma yadidaṃ cedaṃ ceti kṛtvā vidhīyate; yathā- ‘varṇaśca svaraśca' ityādi|
analyzed: samuccayaḥ nāma yat idam ca idam ca iti kṛtvā vidhīyate yathā varṇaḥ ca svaraḥ ca ityādi

original: nidarśanaṃ nāma- mūrkhaviduṣāṃ buddhisāmyaviṣayo dṛṣṭāntaḥ; yathā- ‘vijñātamamṛtaṃ yathā' ityādi|
analyzed: nidarśanam nāma mūrkha viduṣām buddhi sāmya viṣayaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ yathā vijñātam amṛtam yathā ityādi

original: nirvacanaṃ nāma paṇḍitabuddhigamyo dṛṣṭāntaḥ; yathā- ‘jñāyate nityagasyeva kālasyātyayakāraṇam' iti|
analyzed: nirvacanam nāma paṇḍita buddhi gamyaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ yathā jñāyate nitya gasya iva kālasya atyaya kāraṇam iti

original: nidarśananirvacanayorayaṃ viśeṣaḥ- yannidarśanaṃ mūrkhaviduṣāṃ buddhisāmānyaviṣayaṃ, nirvacanaṃ tu paṇḍitabuddhivedyameva; kiṃvā nirvacanaṃ niruktiḥ- yathā- ‘vividhaṃ sarpati yato visarpastena saṃjñitaḥ' ityādi| niyogo nāma avaśyānuṣṭheyatayā vidhānaṃ; yathā- ‘na tvayā svedamūrcchāparītenāpi piṇḍikaiṣā vimoktavyā' ityādi|
analyzed: nidarśana nirvacanayoḥ ayam viśeṣaḥ yat nidarśanam mūrkha viduṣām buddhi sāmānya viṣayam nirvacanam tu paṇḍita buddhi vedyam eva kiṃvā nirvacanam niruktiḥ yathā vividham sarpati yatas visarpaḥ tena saṃjñitaḥ ityādi niyogaḥ nāma avaśya anuṣṭheya tayā vidhānam yathā na tvayā sveda mūrcchā parītena api piṇḍikā eṣā vimoktavyā ityādi

original: vikalpaḥ pākṣikābhidhānaṃ; yathā- ‘sārodakaṃ vā'tha kuśodakaṃ vā' ityādi|
analyzed: vikalpaḥ pākṣika abhidhānam yathā sāra udakam vā atha kuśa udakam vā ityādi

original: pratyutsāro nāma upapattyā paramatanivāraṇaṃ; yathā vāryovidaḥ prāha- ‘rasajāni tu bhūtāni rajasā vyādhayaḥ smṛtāḥ'ityādi, hiraṇyākṣā niṣedhayati- ‘na hyātmā rajasaḥ smṛtaḥ'ityādi|
analyzed: pratyutsāraḥ nāma upapattyā para mata nivāraṇam yathā vāryovidaḥ prāha rasa jāni tu bhūtāni rajasā vyādhayaḥ smṛtāḥ ityādi hiraṇyākṣā niṣedhayati na hi ātmā rajasaḥ smṛtaḥ ityādi

original: uddhāro nāma parapakṣadūṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā svapakṣoddharaṇaṃ; yathā- ‘yeṣāmeva hi bhāvānāṃ sampat sañjanayennaram| teṣāmeva hi bhāvānāṃ vipadvyādhīnudīrayet' ityādinā svapakṣoddharaṇam|
analyzed: uddhāraḥ nāma para pakṣa dūṣaṇam kṛtvā sva pakṣa uddharaṇam yathā yeṣām eva hi bhāvānām sampad sañjanayet naram teṣām eva hi bhāvānām vipad vyādhīn udīrayet ityādinā sva pakṣa uddharaṇam

original: sambhavo nāma yadyasminnupapadyate sa tasya sambhavaḥ; yathā- mukhe pipluvyaṅganīlikādayaḥ sambhavantītyādi| ityetāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattantrayuktayo vyāhṛtāḥ|
analyzed: sambhavaḥ nāma yat yasmin upapadyate sa tasya sambhavaḥ yathā mukhe piplu vyaṅga nīlikā ādayaḥ sambhavanti ityādi iti etāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśat tantra yuktayaḥ vyāhṛtāḥ
